subject: Request to expand demo audience — need new slot to include InfoSec & Procurement
messages:
From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@astrahealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: infra.lead@astrahealth.com, security@astrahealth.com, procurement@astrahealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood demo — adding InfoSec & Procurement (need to move)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the demo invite. We're excited to see Redwood next week, but the attendee list has expanded on our side. Our CISO (added on security@astrahealth.com), procurement, and the infra lead need to attend so we can sign off on network/networking and procurement terms.

Two constraints from our side: our CISO will be traveling and unavailable on Monday 1 Mar (red-eye travel that day), and Procurement needs a 60–90 minute slot (they want time for contract/terms discussion).

Can we move the session to a new date that accommodates InfoSec + Procurement + Infra? Ideally the session is 60 minutes with room to extend to 90 if needed. If you can propose 3 windows next week (we are primarily ET but can do early PT), that would be great. Please include an agenda, whether you need customer SSO setup beforehand, and any pre-demo checklist we should review.

Also can you share the SOW draft and a short mutual action plan ahead of time? That will help Procurement prepare.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Park
Head of Partnerships | AstraHealth
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — adding InfoSec & Procurement (need to move)

Hi Lisa —

Totally understand and thanks for the heads up. Happy to expand the session and move it so all stakeholders can be present. We recommend a 60-minute session with a clear 15-minute block at the end for procurement/questions; we can extend to 90 if you prefer.

Proposed windows (all times shown both PT / ET):
- Wed, Mar 3 — 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (60–90m)
- Thu, Mar 4 — 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (60–90m)
- Fri, Mar 5 — 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET (60m)

Could you confirm which stakeholders will join each slot (CISO, procurement lead, infra lead)? We'll hold the two preferred times tentatively until we hear back.

I've attached a short agenda and a one-page mutual action plan template to this thread, and I'm looping in Dev (solutions) and Marissa (your AE) to own the demo and follow-up items.

If your CISO still can't make the week of Mar 1, we can push into the following week — just let us know.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
ATTACHMENTS: Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page)
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Lisa Park <lisa.park@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — adding InfoSec & Procurement (need to move)

On Tue, Feb 24, 2026 at 10:03 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> I've attached a short agenda and a one-page mutual action plan template to this thread, and I'm looping in Dev (solutions) and Marissa (your AE) to own the demo and follow-up items.

Hi all — quick technical note from my side: happy to join either proposed slot. For InfoSec and Infra, we'll prepare a platform readiness checklist and a network connectivity slide (IP ranges, egress rules, dataflow diagram). If your security team has any specific questionnaire items (CSPM, syslogs, retention), please share ahead of time and I’ll surface those in the demo.

Prefer Thu Mar 4 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET if that works for your CISO — gives me time to pull logs and a compact demo of our cache/quantization behavior. I will prepare the pre-demo checklist here: https://drive.google.com/example-pre-demo-checklist

Thanks,
Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@astrahealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: security@astrahealth.com, procurement@astrahealth.com, infra.lead@astrahealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — adding InfoSec & Procurement (need to move)

Thanks Stephanie and Dev —

Mar 4 at 13:00 ET (Thu) works best for the group — our CISO will be available then (confirmed). We prefer a 60-minute meeting with a hard stop, but Procurement would like the option to extend to 90 if contract quesitons take longer.

I'll send the calendar invite from our side and include security@astrahealth.com, procurement@astrahealth.com, and infra.lead@astrahealth.com. Please add the SOW draft and the MAP to the invite so Procurement can review before the meeting. Also—we'll need recording enabled and a short section on data residency and audit logs.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=ast-demo-20260304

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Lisa
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@astrahealth.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — adding InfoSec & Procurement (need to move)

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Lisa. I've accepted the invite on our side and attached the SOW draft (MVP-SOW-v0.3.docx) and the agenda (Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf) to the calendar entry.

What we'll bring to Mar 4, 13:00 ET:
- 30m product demo (focus: deployment modes, latency/throughput tradeoffs)
- 15m security & compliance deep-dive (audit logs, retention, KMS/HSM options)
- 15m procurement/next-steps (Mutual Action Plan, licensing, timeline)

Dev will cover technical readiness and any checklist items; Marissa will run the procurement portion and follow up on next steps.

If anyone needs a pre-demo tech sync (15–20m) before Thu, comment here and we’ll schedule.

Best,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
ATTACHMENTS: MVP-SOW-v0.3.docx (draft), Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf
